set.body:
## Objective

Cache unique-point values/world gradients and patch v,L,c,w,z once per linearization. Implement G^T P G h/L^2 and signed RHS via gather, centering, rank-one projection, scatter and geometry transpose.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 10, FA-07. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `matrix-free patch operator`
- `linearization cache and scatter tests`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Products and RHS match explicit dense GN for 6,12,64,96,128+ coefficients including repeated indices and invalid patches.
2. Every Krylov product performs zero image interpolation/gradient calls.
3. Cache invalidation follows accepted state/sample IDs; memory counters expose O(U*K) basis tables and forbid hidden K*K production normals.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N02: FA-N02: Implement typed point JVP/VJP geometry operations
- L02: FA-L02: Implement streamed rigid/affine sufficient statistics
- L07: FA-L07: Implement frozen weighted sample sets and holdout roles
- L08: FA-L08: Deduplicate exact sample points and reuse affine stencil geometry
- L10: FA-L10: Assemble the specialized rigid objective linearization

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-N03: Implement cached matrix-free projected-patch curvature and RHS
